Subject: RE: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline — legal summary

Neha / Karthik — I reviewed Vertex's MSA redline and attached a tracked changes document (Vertex_MSA_Redline_20271115.docx). Summary below: 

- Acceptable: Most commercial edits, ordering/fees, and Service descriptions.
- Needs negotiation: Section 7 (Data Processing) — ask for clearer language on subcontractor handling, and Section 11 (Confidentiality) needs a shorter carve-out for aggregated telemetry.
- Material concern: Section 9 (Indemnity & Liability) requests unlimited indemnity and no cap on consequential damages. We cannot accept unlimited indemnity. Proposed counter: liability cap at $5,000,000 and limitation on consequential damages.

Procurement/ops items for the portal: 
- Ariba requires the following fields for successful PO acceptance: BillToCode, ShipToCode, TaxID, Insurance Certificate name + expiry, PaymentTermsCode, and VendorID.
- For EDI/PO splitting: legal doesn't object to split POs, but contract should reflect that partial shipments may lead to multiple invoices and Redwood may consolidate payments per invoice rules.

I'll be available for a 30-min call tomorrow 11/16 at 11am PT to walk through the redline if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Vertex_MSA_Redline_20271115.docx

Hi all — quick technical notes after reviewing OrderForm_Specs_Ariba_20271115.xlsx and Ariba_FieldMap.csv: 

1) PO splitting: we support split POs but need Vertex to indicate a grouping ID (POGroupID) when they want shipments consolidated into a single invoice. If not provided, Redwood will treat each PO line as independently invoiced.
2) GL codes: Redwood expects a single GL field per line item named GLAccountCode (string, 10 chars). If Vertex sends multiple cost-center level codes, include primary GL in GLAccountCode and other attributes as POLineAttribute_x.
3) EDI dates: use YYYY-MM-DD for ShipDate and YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ for timestamps.

Action: can someone from Vertex confirm the POGroupID field or let us know if you prefer Redwood to infer grouping by PO number + batch flag? Also, vendor-ops@ariba.com — is there any standard Ariba header we should expect that changes during enrollment?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference
